title: Javastefia77
description: JavaStefia77 is a premium liquid stevia sweetener made from grade A Stevia rebaudiana leaf extract, rich in Rebaudioside A (Reb-A) for a naturally sweet taste without any bitter aftertaste. Free from dextrose and maltodextrin, Javastefia77 is safe for diabetics, low in calories, and ideal for a healthy lifestyle. Available in 3 flavors and related health articles.

title: Nutriflakes
description: This project involves creating a high-performance landing page for Nutriflakes, a cereal brand that focuses on digestive health. The website is optimized for conversion and SEO, with fast loading times and a responsive design. It includes sections on product benefits, product ingredients, customer testimonials, articles about the product and health, and video content.
